chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Uthman, who said: Abu Abdillah Al-Mada'ini narrated to me from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Indeed, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, created a star in the seventh orbit, and He created it from cold water, while the rest of the six flowing stars were created from hot water. It is the star of the Prophets and the Successors, and it is the star of the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him), which commands exiting the world and asceticism in it, and commands lying on the dust, resting on bricks, wearing coarse clothing, and eating tasteless food. And Allah did not create a star closer to Allah, the Exalted, than it.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the star created from cold water in Shia theology?
ai.summary: In Shia cosmology, this 'Star of the Prophets and Successors' (Najm al-Anbiya wa al-Awsiya) is often interpreted as a luminous spiritual entity or the light of Imam Ali, residing in the highest celestial sphere. Its creation from 'cold water' signifies purity and tranquility, contrasting with the other stars, and serves as a divine directive for the Imams to embody asceticism (zuhd) and simplicity. This celestial metaphor reinforces the theological concept that the Imam’s authority is not merely political but a cosmic guide leading humanity toward detachment from worldly distractions.

en.hubeali: H 14817 – A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al-Hassan Bin Ali Bin Usman who said: Abu Abdullah Al-Mada’iny narrated from Abu Abdullahasws having said that:

So he<sup>azwj</sup> Created it from cold water and the rest of the six stars flowed from hot water, and it is the star of the Prophets<sup>as</sup>, and the successors<sup>asws</sup> and it is the star of Amir-ul-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> commanding the exit from the world, and the ascetism in it, and commanding for the dust to be the mattress, and bricks to rest upon (for a pillow), and coarse clothing, and eating the tasteless (food), and Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has not Created a star more closer to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the High, than it’.
